🎙
Remarks
by Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at
the UN Security Council meeting on Ukraine
(New York, September 23, 2026)
💬
Had
the 2015 Minsk agreements
, reaffirmed in Paris in 2019 – with Zelensky already in office – been implemented as required by the UN Security Council,
Ukraine would still be within its 1991 borders, except, of course, for Crimea
.
That issue has long been settled
, as everyone fully understands. <...>
Russia’s December 2021 proposals
to reach an agreement based on mutual respect for the security interests of Russia and the countries of Europe and North America were
arrogantly rejected by NATO and the Biden administration
.
In practice, preparations were being made for Kiev
to seize by force the territories of Donbass beyond its control
. To prevent this Western scenario from unfolding, we were compelled to launch
the special military operation
in February 2022. Just a week later, the Ukrainian side requested
negotiations
. We agreed.
After several rounds in Belarus and Istanbul, the Ukrainian side proposed key principles for a settlement,
which our negotiators accepted
. Crucially, these enshrined Ukraine’s
neutral status
, recognised
the realities on the ground
and provided
collective security guarantees
offering reliable protection against any recurrence of armed provocations or attempts at aggression.
The document was
initialled
by the Ukrainian and Russian delegations,
but everyone knows what happened to it
. <...>
☝️
Had that
initialled agreement
been formalised in a treaty and implemented,
Ukraine would, once again, have retained its 1991 borders, but without Crimea and part of Donbass.
<...>
Russia
– as President
Vladimir Putin
has
repeatedly reaffirmed
–
is ready for negotiations to achieve precisely such a lasting and just peace
. The tasks that must be accomplished to achieve this goal were clearly outlined in
President Vladimir Putin’s keynote address in June 2024
.
❗️
However, having learned from
bitter experience
,
we will not suspend the special military operation for the duration of negotiations, whatever their format.
Yet this is precisely what Europe wants, with the same simple aim of
securing a respite and replenishing the depleted arsenals of the Kiev regime
, which, out of desperation, has long since resorted to
openly terrorist methods
.
***
As we can see,
Greenland is neither Crimea nor Donbass
, and “never the twain shall meet”. We eagerly await the next episode of this “series”. It will be interesting to hear the Secretariat’s response to any questions journalists may ask about the plans of
Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
.
We hope that the next Secretary-General will bring the statements of Secretariat officials
back into line with international law
.
👉
The Declaration on Principles of International Law concerning Friendly Relations and Cooperation among States in accordance with the Charter of the UN
clearly stipulates that the principles of sovereignty and territorial integrity apply to s
tates that respect the principle of equal rights and self-determination of peoples
and have
a government representing the whole people belonging to the territory
, without distinction as to race, creed or colour.
I believe it is obvious to everyone that
the Kiev regime cannot be regarded as a government representing the interests of the people of Crimea, Donbass and Novorossiya
, whom it has time and again branded
“terrorists, subhumans and specimen”
.

item.title: 🗓 #Announcement The St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum will take place on September 24-26, 2026.
item.description: #Announcement 🗓 The St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum will take place on September 24-26, 2026. Held since 2012, the Forum has established itself as a unique platform for cooperation in culture and the arts, as well as for open and substantive discussions of issues arising as the contemporary cultural landscape evolves. The Forum will be one of the key events of the Year of Unity of the Peoples of Russia , proclaimed by Presidential Executive Order No. 962 of December 25, 2025 . The event is expected to bring together representatives of 70 countries , with 44 official foreign delegations confirmed, around 2,500 delegates set to attend the main programme and nearly 1,500 participants already registered for the Forum’s first-ever youth programme. 💬 Russia's Deputy Prime Minister, Chair of the Forum’s organising committee Tatyana Golikova said to TASS Agency in the run-up to the Forum : We can see that attempts to cancel Russian culture and isolate our country have clearly failed. The St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum reflects Russia’s unifying role as a spiritual and cultural guide and as a champion of traditional values. • More about the Forum • Business programme

item.title: 🗓 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov chaired the traditional meeting
item.description: 🗓 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov chaired the traditional meeting of Foreign Ministers of the member states of the Collective Security Treaty Organisation ( #CSTO ) in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly. The Ministers held a constructive and engaged exchange of views on prospects for building an architecture of equal and indivisible security in Eurasia , including the drafting of a Eurasian Charter of Diversity and Multipolarity in the 21st Century . They also discussed current international and regional security issues , focusing on the situation in the CSTO’s area of responsibility. The Ministers stressed the need to coordinate the efforts of CSTO member states in international forums, above all at the UN , and the importance of further strengthening cooperation between the CSTO and the UN. 🤝 The Sides reviewed preparations for the key event of Russia’s CSTO chairmanship – the session of the CSTO Collective Security Council in Moscow on November 11, 2026. #RussiaCSTO #UNGA81

🎙
Russia's Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova
answered a media question
regarding the signing of a declaration on a hundred-year partnership by the leaders of Canada and Ukraine
(September 23, 2026)
❓
Question: During his visit to Canada, Zelensky signed a document that is already drawing mixed reactions on both sides of the Atlantic. How would you comment on the signing of the declaration on a hundred-year partnership between Canada and Ukraine?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
We continue to watch Zelensky travel the world in search of support, including the military aid he needs
to continue the slaughter he has unleashed against his own people.
On September 10-11, he visited Canada. The visit saw the signing of several bilateral documents, including
a declaration on a hundred-year partnership
between the two countries. It announced plans to conclude
a corresponding agreement on a comprehensive strategic partnership
between Canada and Ukraine by the end of this year.
🤔
Impartial commentators are already asking on social media:
will Canadian taxpayers really have to support Ukraine for the next hundred years?
Will they be able to claim tax deductions for Zelensky and his entourage as dependants?
It is hard to argue with that point
👉
the Kiev junta has become an international freeloader, carried on the West’s back
.
Against this backdrop, Canada also announced that it would supply its protégés in Kiev with
interceptor missiles worth 350 million Canadian dollars
.
We have a word of advice for the signatories:
no good comes of agreements like these
.
❗️
Pumping Ukraine full of weapons only puts peace further out of reach and directly involves Western countries in the conflict, making them complicit in Ukrainian neo-Nazi crimes.
Any shipments of military equipment destined for Kiev become
legitimate targets for
Russia's Armed Forces
. We have warned of this
repeatedly
.
A hundred years is a long time.
All we can do is wish Canadian citizens patience.
The logic of Ottawa, like that of Washington, should be clear to them:
the longer the conflict rages, the more orders flow to the military-industrial complex
, and so on.
☝️
But patience, as we know
,
has its limits
. Sooner or later, Canadians will ask why their money is being spent on a war on the other side of the world instead of healthcare and roads.

On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio
held a meeting
in New York on the sidelines of
the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
.
They held
an in-depth exchange of views on a wide range of bilateral and international issues
, building on recent contacts at the highest level.
Discussing the Ukraine conflict resolution, Russia’s Foreign Minister drew attention to
the close coordination between the Kiev regime and its European sponsors
. They examined in detail
Kiev’s destructive actions
,
including deliberate strikes against civilians
and
cross-border infrastructure
, which destabilise global energy markets.
The Russian Side reaffirmed its
unconditional commitment to achieving the goals
of the special military operation
, including through a political and diplomatic settlement of the conflict that addresses its root causes.
International and regional issues discussed
included the situation in the Middle East, the South Caucasus, Latin America and the Caribbean, as well as efforts to counter illegitimate practices by certain multilateral institutions in the field of international law.
They also reviewed
preparations for the
#G20
events
scheduled before the end of the year.
The Russian Side also stressed
the need to restore bilateral relations to a sound footing as soon as possible, in accordance with
the agreements
reached by the Presidents of Russia and the United States
. This is particularly relevant as discussions intensify on prospects for economic cooperation, cultural and humanitarian exchanges, easier travel between the two countries, and closer ties between their societies and citizens.
Naturally, this requires
an honest dialogue on removing “irritants”
and restoring normal working conditions for both countries’ diplomatic missions, including the return of Russian property in the US that has effectively been confiscated.
🤝
The Sides agreed to maintain contacts on all these issues through their Foreign Ministries.
#RussiaUS
